title: Oracle query for an input bit
statement: For every bit string $y$ and natural number $a$, the first oracle returns the bit of $y$ at position $a$ on the encoded query $\langle y,\mathrm{bits}(a)\rangle$, taking the value false when $a$ is outside the string.
